verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer platform page lists 'search' as one of the features the DBX Platform can add to apps, but no evidence pack item documents an actual Search API endpoint, its full-text content matching behavior, or confirms it goes beyond filename/prefix matching; Dash search (dropbox-docs-11) is a separate consumer product not a developer API. missing for 10: documented /files/search endpoint reference, evidence of full-text content indexing, and confirmation it isn't limited to prefix/filename matching.
